notes:
1. Zero-Hover Architecture: Eliminated all hover transforms, scale jumps, translateY shifts, and hover-triggered action reveals across every page, button, table row, and modal in the software. All actions are permanently visible and click-driven.
2. Light & Dark Theme Support: Seamless one-click Light Mode / Dark Mode toggle in TopNav with instant HTML class switching and persistent storage.
3. Synchronous Embedded Startup Emblem: Embedded Base64 architectural vector emblem and direct fallback ensuring 100% reliable startup rendering with zero broken image placeholders.
4. Minimal Import & OCR Redesign: Removed congested dark hero box and redundant module cards, replacing with a streamlined executive header, dedicated subpage views (OCR Document Digitizer, Bulk CSV / Excel Catalog, Bank Statement Reconciler), and row limit filters (10 | 20 | 50 | 100).
5. Complete Removal of Orders Page: Fully cleaned up legacy orders module, streamlined billing actions to minimal text-based controls, removed walk-in cash customer button, and added named hold order recall queue.
